entities.summary: Karl Alfons Borromäus Josef Penecke was an Austro-Hungarian geologist, paleontologist at the University of Graz. He was also a keen entomologist with an interest in the beetles of the Styrian region. He went missing in Cernăuți (Czernowitz), Romania, at the end of World War II.
